movie-monitor 1.1.1 summary: Major refactor with reorganization of core scripts and updated copy/rename rules.

- Moved all core scripts and config files from the scripts/ subfolder to the main directory for easier access and management.
- Added support for automatic renaming rules: now supports both movie and multi-episode naming conventions with smart episode detection.
- SKILL.md updated with new copy/rename documentation and TMDB image proxy config note.
- TMDB image download now optionally uses a configurable `image_proxy` (default `http://127.0.0.1:7890`).
- No core logic changes to movie grabbing, filtering, or 115/NAS workflows.
